name: George W. Ball
sources: Ancestry.com, 1850 United States Federal Census (Subdivision 22, Meigs County, Tennessee)
Ancestry.com, 1860 United States Federal Census (District 2, McMinn County, Tennessee)
Ancestry.com, 1900 United States Federal Census (Civil District 2, McMinn County, Tennessee)
Ancestry.com, Tennessee, U.S., Wills and Probate Records, 1779-2008 (George W. Ball, 1908)
notes: Child of David Tate Ball and Draden (Davis) Ball; a brother of Ellen Rogers (Ball) McPhail. Born Oct 1844; aged 6 in 1850 and 15 in 1860. In 1900 he was a widowed farmer in Civil District 2, McMinn County, next door to his mother and his sister Nancy, with a son and two daughters. He died in 1908: his will was dated 20 Mar 1908 and probated on 7 Apr 1908 (the tree gives his death as 26 Mar 1908).

In 1900 his household held his son John F. (born Oct 1872) and daughters Hattie E. (Aug 1879) and Martha (Dec 1882). His will names three children, Mollie Carroll (wife of Will Carroll), Johnnie Ball and Dasie Ball, and a granddaughter, Eva Brickell.
